biotools.summary: STRhub is an open-access, web-based platform for forensic short tandem repeat (STR) genetics, built for education, teaching and research support. It provides a catalogue of 228 STR markers (CODIS core, other autosomal, X-STRs and Y-STRs) with GRCh38/GRCh37 coordinates, repeat motifs, ISFG/STRNaming sequence structures and MPS kit coverage from STRidER's FSSG; population allele frequencies and summary statistics from capillary electrophoresis (pop.STR / SP-SMART) and sequencing (1000 Genomes Project) datasets, explorable in charts and downloadable as tables; a DNA mixture simulator that contrasts CE and NGS behaviour; an STR motif explorer over the ISFG minimum range; a FASTA generator with configurable flanking regions; an embedded IGV.js viewer with 1000 Genomes demo reads; and educational articles in English, Spanish and Portuguese. STRhub is not a casework tool and does not replace validated forensic software.
